e: The International Criminal Court convicts former Seleka commander Mahamat Said Abdel Kani of crimes against humanity during his administration of running a detention facility in Bangui during the Central African Republic Civil War in 2013.

The French Foreign Ministry opens disciplinary proceedings against its ambassador to the Central African Republic, Bruno Foucher, following allegations that he brought around 30 young women to his official residence in Bangui between January 2024 and March 2026.

The Special Criminal Court in Bangui begins the trial in absentia of former president François Bozizé, on charges of crimes against humanity, murder, enforced disappearances, rape committed by members of his Presidential Guard, and torture.
Eight people are killed when an artisanal mine collapses in Nourroum, Ouham-Pendé.
The Constitutional Court validates President Faustin-Archange Touadéra's victory in the 2025 Central African general election.
